# Graphics/Window

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Display.h](Display.h): What a display is, from an app's point of view - which is: how big a window may I make, and where may I put it. (declares `Display`, `primaryDisplay`)
- [EmbeddedView.h](EmbeddedView.h): declares `EmbeddedViewOptions`, `EmbeddedView`
- [KeyEchoes.h](KeyEchoes.h): Logic's AUHostingServiceXPC bounces a forwarded key straight back in, re-encoded but keeping its timestamp. (declares `isEchoOfForwardedKey`)
- [KeyForwarding.h](KeyForwarding.h): declares `NativeKeyEvent`, `EmbedderKeyForwarder`
- [KeyGrab.h](KeyGrab.h): declares `KeyGrab`
- [NativeChildSurface.h](NativeChildSurface.h): A rectangle in one of our layouts that somebody else's native view is parented into — the inverse of EmbeddedView. (declares `NativeChildSurface`)
- [SizeConstraint.h](SizeConstraint.h): Which side of a window the user is moving. (declares `ResizeAxis`, `ResizeRequest`, `SizeConstraint`, `resizeAxisBetween`, `fitWithin`, `AspectRatioLock`)
- [ViewWindow.h](ViewWindow.h): declares `ViewWindow`, `runWindowedApp`
- [Window.h](Window.h): declares `WindowFlags`, `ResizeCallback`, `WillResizeCallback`, `WindowEvents`, `WindowOptions`, `Window`
- [WindowInput.h](WindowInput.h): Sees every key and mouse event the platform hands a window, before its views do, and every change of the window's key focus. (declares `WindowInputListener`, `WindowInputTap`)
